paite: Ngai dih ua, huai nite leh huai hun a, Judah leh Jerusalem saltangte ka kaihkhop hun chiang in,
heading: Namte Tung A Pathian Thukhenna

paite: nam chih ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah ka pisuk ding hi. Huai ah, nam chih lak a athehdalh uh, ka mi, ka goutan Israelte tung a agamtatna uh leh, ka gam akihawmna ziak un, atung uah amaute toh thukhenna ka bawlpih ding;
ka mite a ding in ai asan ua, kizuakna man ding in pasal naupang apia ua, uain adawntheihna ding un, aman ding in numei naupang azuak uhi.

"Ahi, aw Tura leh Sidon leh Philistia gam tengteng aw, kei a ding in bang na hi ua le? Na thuk ding ua hia? N'on thuk uleh, hattak in, kintak in na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka hon thuk sam ding hi.
Ka dangkasik leh adangka-eng na la ua, ka thil hoihtak deihhuaite na tempul sung uah na tawilut uhi;
Judah tate leh Jerusalem tate leng agamgi ua kipan gamlapi a na suanmang theihna ding un, Grik tapate kiang ah na zuakta uhi.
Ngai dih ua, na zuakna mun ua kipan in tokthou in ka pawtsak ding a, na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka thuk sam ding hi.
Judah tate khut ah na tapate uh leh na tanute uh ka zuak ding, amau gamlapi ah Sheba mite kiang ah azuak ding uhi," TOUPA'N achita hi.
Namte lak ah hiai puang unla; kidou ding in kisa unla; mihat mahmahte tokthou un; kidoumi tengtengte hong nai uhenla, hong paitou uhen.
Na leilehna mukzumte uh namsau ding in sek unla, teipi ding in na theikung kuaika temtate uh sek un; mihat lou in leng ka hat chi hen.
Akim a nam tengteng aw, kin unla, hong pai unla kikaikhawm un; Aw TOUPA, huai ah na mihat mahmahte paisuksak in.
Namte kitokthou uhenla Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah hong paitou uhen; huai ah akim a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in ka tu ding hi.
Na kawite uh suah un, buhlak ahun hi; hong pai unla, childen un; grep sukna khuk adim a, bel adimlet a; akhelhna uh athupi hi.
Mipi tampite, thukhenna phaizang a mipi tampite! Thupukna Phaizang ah, TOUPA ni anaita hi!
Ni leh kha hihmial in om ding ua, aksite'n avakna uh asel ding uh.

TOUPA Zion tang a kipan in ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; leitung leh vante aling ding ua; himahleh TOUPA zaw amite a ding in kihumbitna leh Israel suante a ding in insang ahi ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Amite Avualzawl Ding

paite: Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka tang siangthou Zion a teng ka hi chih na thei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem asiangthou ding a, mikhual kuamah apaisuak nawn kei ding.

Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, tang sangte'n uain khum akaisak ding ua, nawitui in mualte aluang ding a; TOUPA' inn a kipan in tuikhuk ahong kikhohkhe ding a, Shittim lui phaizang anomsak ding hi.
Judah tate tung ah engbawltak a agam ua sisan asuah ziak un, Aigupta asegawp ding a, Edom gam gamdai gamkeu asuak ding hi.
Judah gam tangtawn in luah in a-om gige ding a, Jerusalem khua suan a kipan suan zel tan in luah in a-om ding.
Huan asisan suahna uh ka sawpsiang louh ka sawpsiang ding a, Zion ah TOUPA ateng gige hi.
